# SparkOllama

SparkOllama is an open-source, local-first conversation client for Ollama with optional session-only
BYOK Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude routes.

Authoritative sources:

- Project and installation: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/SparkOllama#readme
- Privacy: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/SparkOllama/blob/main/docs/privacy.md
- Architecture and trust boundary: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/SparkOllama/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
- Known limitations: https://github.com/Sparkience-AI/SparkOllama/blob/main/docs/limitations.md

The complete product runs locally. There is no hosted SparkOllama service or agentic tool execution.
Cloud routes are disabled until the user selects one, provides a key, and confirms transmission.
The Ollama API is unauthenticated by default and must remain loopback-only.
